title: Implement a deterministic retry policy with exponential backoff
prompt: src/retry.py declares RetryPolicy and call_with_retry but does not implement them. Implement both. RetryPolicy(max_attempts, base_delay, max_delay, multiplier, jitter) computes the delay before attempt n (where n >= 2, so attempt 2 is the first retry) as base_delay * multiplier ** (n - 2), capped at max_delay; delay_for(1) is 0.0. When jitter is enabled the delay is multiplied by a factor drawn from the injected Random instance in [0.5, 1.5]; with jitter disabled the Random instance must not be touched at all. call_with_retry(operation, policy, sleeper, retry_on) calls operation(), returning its result on success. On an exception listed in retry_on it sleeps for the computed delay and retries, up to max_attempts total calls; the final failure is re-raised unchanged. Exceptions not listed in retry_on propagate immediately without sleeping.
acceptance_criteria: A successful first call performs no sleep and no retry.
Delays follow base_delay * multiplier ** (attempt - 2) for attempt >= 2, capped at max_delay.
With jitter disabled the injected Random is never consulted.
With jitter enabled each delay is scaled by a factor in [0.5, 1.5] drawn from the injected Random.
An exception outside retry_on propagates immediately with no sleep.
After max_attempts failures the last exception is re-raised unchanged.
The total number of operation calls never exceeds max_attempts.
